figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(budget_cents) budget FROM budgets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY department_id,account_id), a AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(expense_cents) actual FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY department_id,account_id) SELECT b.department_id,b.account_id,b.budget budget_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0) actual_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget variance_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget)/NULLIF(b.budget,0),2) variance_pct,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.actual,0)>b.budget*1.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END over_budget FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.department_id=b.department_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id ORDER BY budget_cents DESC

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(budget_cents) budget FROM budgets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY department_id,account_id),
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 b，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: a AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(expense_cents) actual FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY department_id,account_id)
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 a，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 取数
parts.sql: SELECT b.department_id,b.account_id,b.budget budget_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0) actual_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget variance_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget)/NULLIF(b.budget,0),2) variance_pct,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.actual,0)>b.budget*1.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END over_budget

parts.label: 来源
parts.sql: FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.department_id=b.department_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id
parts.note: 数据来自 中间结果 b、中间结果 a，并用 ON 后面的条件把它们的行配起来。

parts.label: 排序
parts.note: 按 budget_cents DESC 排列结果。

figures.title: 预算偏差率
figures.meaning: 衡量实际费用相对预算多了或少了多少，用于预算执行检查。
figures.interpretation: 预算偏差率 {result}：实际费用比预算多（正数）或少（负数）的比例。

notes.label: 粒度
notes.text: 每部门每科目一行，以预算为保留侧

notes.label: 标记
notes.text: 超过预算110%才标记，恰好110%不标记

notes.label: 易错口径
notes.text: 按部门直接连接预算月行和实际凭证行后求和，或用 ABS 汇总费用
分母为 0 时，结果为空（NULL），不会报错，也不会写成 0。
